markdown:
**Corporation Name.** Waffle Home

**CEO.** Cornwallis Startwout

**Years in business.** Unknown

**Industry.** Breakfast food served 24/7, disaster relief and technocult

**Motto.** *"Good food fast."*

**Impact.** Unfathomable

The origins of Waffle Home have been lost to the sands of time, but rumors say that the technocult business began its life in the old world. Many attempt to discredit these rumors however, offering a multitude of explanations for how the entity got its start… but no one's able to decide which story is right.

Day to day, Waffle Home operates over a thousand chain restaurants that double as holy sites, known as Houses. Each House is tended to by a specially selected individual from the members there, known only as a Lord Belgian. They act as both manager and religious leader, ensuring that hot and tasty meals are served to customers and spiritual, syrupy needs are fulfilled. In the event of a local natural or manmade catastrophe, the Lord Belgian will do everything in their power to ensure their parish is open and available. As a result, Neon City residents have come to see these Houses as indicators for utility access in an area—if the waffles are still served hot and fluffy, then obviously something is working.

A lesser-known aspect of the Waffle Home religious creed is the belief of ritual combat. Every House has a designated zone either outside or in their basement (for violence within the strict confines of the House is forbidden) for use in case of a challenge or spar. As such, the business has bred a hardy stock of fighters, and each House can hold its own if threatened.

**Owner.** *Unclaimed*

**Creator.** *Neon City Nights*, JessicaShtebs, Assorted Beanie#0512

**Fixer Use.** Open; any fixer can run quests related to it.

**CEO Use.** Restricted; please request permission from the owner if using the CEO for a game.
